summary: @ornikar/stylelint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a stylelint configuration but its package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled 727 KB file, math_init.js. math_init.js is a Bun-bundled JavaScript blob (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a shuffled string-array decoder and hex-mangled identifiers, not readable source. The declared main entry index.js is not present in the tarball, so installing the package has no library effect — only the preinstall dropper runs. Fetching a second runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling file that a Node-based inspection tool cannot easily read is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, and it has no legitimate connection to a stylelint config package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
